response:
Reflection: the frontier has converged on a clear recipe. Smoothing the accrual leg over three years is the dominant portfolio improvement (alpha 5.8%), industry demeaning is the dominant precision improvement, and combining them (gen-6 Signal 1) produced the archive's best t-statistic on alpha (6.09) with 5.3% alpha and no coverage loss — the first signal strong on both criteria simultaneously. Extending the window to five years added nothing beyond three, so accrual persistence saturates quickly; adding accrual volatility diluted both metrics, so the second moment is not the operative channel. The remaining untested combinations are (a) all three corrections at once (industry + smoothing + earnings-scaled deflator), (b) the rank-product geometry — historically the best FMB slope — applied to the smoothed accrual, and (c) smoothing applied to the high-coverage cash-flow-preferred accrual leg. I also keep one genuinely different geometry (dollar netting with a chronic accrual) and one three-leg test of whether profitability momentum adds information.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: IndNeutralChronicPercentAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), IND_ADJ(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), WINSOR(ABS(ib), 1)), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: The most credible profitability is a high within-industry margin combined with a persistently small share of reported earnings coming from working-capital accruals, measured relative to industry norms.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This is the only untested combination of the three corrections that each independently improved the metrics — industry demeaning (t=6.18 FMB), three-year smoothing (alpha 5.8%), and the earnings-scaled deflator (best Sharpe) — and each addresses a distinct contamination: sector heterogeneity, annual noise, and firm scale of earnings. If the gains are complementary it should dominate the current frontier signal on both criteria.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: ChronicAccrualRankProduct
EXPRESSION: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Credibility is multiplicative: a chronic absence of accrual reliance should amplify the return premium on a high margin rather than merely add to it, so the rank product of the two industry-relative percentiles should maximize cross-sectional slope precision.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Rank products delivered the archive's highest FMB t-statistics (6.28 and 6.84) but always with the noisy annual accrual, while smoothing has so far only been paired with additive aggregation. Testing the two together isolates aggregation geometry conditional on the improved accrual measurement and determines which form to carry into final consolidation.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: ChronicCashFlowPreferredAccrual
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(IND_ADJ(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), IND_ADJ(MA(COALESCE(RATIO(ADD(recch, ADD(invch, apalch)), at), NEG(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at))), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: Averaging three years of the cash-flow-statement working-capital accrual — the measurement free of merger and reclassification artifacts — gives the cleanest possible reading of a profitable firm's habitual cash conversion, at the archive's widest coverage.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The COALESCE accrual leg gave the highest coverage (0.121) with solid alpha, and smoothing was the single most valuable transformation discovered, but the two have never been applied to the same leg. If this matches Signal 1 on alpha while covering more of the sample, it is the more robust candidate for the final signal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: ConjunctiveChronicQuality
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: Only firms that clear both hurdles — high industry-relative margin and chronically low accruals — qualify as durable profitability, and requiring the conjunction should build a purer long decile than any weighted average.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The conjunctive minimum performed respectably with annual accruals (alpha 4.4%, t=4.35) and its economic reading matches the credibility story most literally, but it has never been combined with the smoothed accrual that fixed the noise problem in the accrual leg. This tests whether the residual weakness of the conjunction was accrual measurement error rather than the geometry itself.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: ProfitLevelMomentumAccrualRestraint
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), SUMRANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 1), NEG(MA(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), at), 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: A firm that is profitable, getting more profitable, and not financing that improvement with accruals is the sharpest case of an underpriced durable earnings stream, since the improvement is verified by the absence of accounting inflation.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The margin-improvement leg standalone produced a high Sharpe (0.48) but modest alpha, suggesting it carries timing information that the level leg lacks, while the chronic accrual leg supplies the credibility filter for that improvement. This tests whether profitability momentum contributes independent information once the level and accrual legs are already present.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: ChronicCashBasedOperatingProfit
EXPRESSION: RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), MA(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), 3)), at)
HYPOTHESIS: Subtracting a firm's typical annual accrual dollars from operating profit dollars yields the sustainable cash earning power of the business, which is what the market underprices; using the three-year average accrual avoids penalizing a firm for one transitory working-capital swing.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Dollar netting is the one interaction geometry structurally different from ranks, and its earlier weak result (FMB t=2.99) plausibly stemmed from subtracting a single noisy accrual realization from a stable profit measure — a mismatch in signal-to-noise that smoothing directly repairs. A strong result here would give an economically interpretable, scale-free quantity rather than a rank composite.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
